title: Project: Shop Inventory
story: The guild shop needs a stock tracker you can trust.
goal: Write class Inventory with add(item, qty=1), remove(item, qty=1) and report(). remove raises ValueError if there is not enough stock (or the item is unknown). report returns a sorted list of "item: qty" strings and skips items with zero stock.
hints: Keep a dictionary on self: item name to quantity.
In remove, check self.stock.get(item, 0) < qty first and raise. In report, loop over sorted items and skip zeros.
socratic: What data structure holds the stock?
Compare your output with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: what is the key idea in “Project: Shop Inventory”?
